partners.title: The fair price is built with you
partners.lede: We are inviting a few Swiss houses to build the reference index with us, based on their closed sales.
partners.step1d: Reference, condition, full set, date and price paid. In whatever form suits you: regular export, file or dedicated access.
partners.step2d: Your sales join those of the other houses. None is shown individually, and no customer data is ever requested.
partners.step3d: A deterministic, reproducible and logged calculation, updated week after week.
partners.trustP1: Shared sales are used solely to calculate the Arka index. They are aggregated before anything is published and are never resold.
partners.trustP2: Arka neither buys nor sells any watch. Our prices reflect the market, nothing else.
partners.termsP1: Every house has its own terms, and we want to know yours.
partners.termsP2: The goal: a fair exchange, for you as much as for us.
partners.ctaLede: A twenty-minute call or a visit to your house, whichever suits you best.
